# kion_funding_source (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion FundingSource by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_funding_source" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the FundingSource to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `end_datecode` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `ou_id` (Number)
- `start_datecode` (String)
